summary.text: Virginia Maloney represents the 4th District on the New York City Council, which includes the Upper East Side, East Midtown, Kips Bay, Turtle Bay, Murray Hill, Sutton Place and Stuyvesant Town.
Her Council website describes her as a lifelong East Side resident whose work focuses on affordability, accountability and access to city services.

paragraphs.text: According to her Council website, Maloney helped expand free public Wi-Fi and fiber infrastructure across New York City during the Bloomberg and de Blasio administrations.

She ran programs at the New York City Economic Development Corporation to support small businesses and attract technical talent, and consulted for the federal government on high-speed rail, telecommunications infrastructure and healthcare outcomes.
